GitHub Plugin Installer

Review a Moodle plugin directly from a public GitHub repository before approving a change.

GitHub Plugin Installer helps administrators retrieve and inspect a single Moodle plugin from a public GitHub repository. It displays the detected component and version, then passes the package to Moodle's normal validation and confirmation process.

A reviewed update workflow
  • Use the repository's default branch or a specific version.
  • Check the plugin component and version before proceeding.
  • Continue with Moodle's own approval screens.
  • Reject invalid packages and version downgrades.
Choose the source
Select a public repository and, when needed, a specific branch, tag or commit instead of manually managing downloaded archives.
Inspect before changing
See whether the package is a new plugin or an update, compare version information and review warnings before continuing.
Keep Moodle in control
The normal Moodle validation and confirmation screens remain responsible for approving the proposed code change.
Less manual downloading, without skipping review

When a maintainer publishes a plugin on GitHub, administrators can identify the relevant release and review the package from one Moodle administration workflow. GitHub Plugin Installer does not execute the downloaded plugin during inspection.

The current version handles public repositories that contain one Moodle plugin. Private repositories, GitHub access tokens and multi-plugin repositories are outside its supported scope. Plugins still undergo Moodle's ordinary compatibility and dependency checks.

Security: GitHub availability does not establish trustworthiness. Inspect the source and maintain a backup and recovery plan before updating plugin files on a production site.
